# Version Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VersionRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

A role or status that an entity holds within a version set according to an authority — a VALUE, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. Standpoint-scoped: 'latest' according to a package registry may differ from 'latest' according to a downstream mirror. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
